name: Esbai
title: Father of Naarai, one of David's mighty men
summary: Esbai is known from the Bible as the father of Naarai (also called Paarai), one of King David's thirty mighty warriors. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles 11:37 in the list of David's brave men. Little else is known about his life beyond his connection to his son who served in David's elite force.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the list of David's mighty men
keyEvents.description: Esbai is mentioned as the father of Naarai, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, in the Chronicles' list of David's brave men.

keyEvents.title: Parallel mention in 2 Samuel
keyEvents.description: In the parallel list in 2 Samuel 23:35, the son is called Paarai from Arbi, providing further context about the family's origin.

keyEvents.title: David's mighty men gather
keyEvents.description: The list of David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles 11 describes the brave men who supported David during his reign, including Esbai's son Naarai.

keyEvents.title: David's warriors in Hebron
keyEvents.description: Many of David's mighty men, including descendants of men like Esbai, helped strengthen David's rule over all Israel when he was crowned in Hebron.
